name: folder-theme
description: Tints the VS Code window with the color of the workspace folder you are working in

commands.title: Folder Theme: Toggle Danger (PROD) for Folder
Folder Theme: Open Terminal in Folder

folderTheme.folders.markdownDescription: Workspace folder name → color: `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `teal`, `blue`, `purple`, `pink` or `#rrggbb`. Only applies in a `.code-workspace`, which is where the colors are written.

folderTheme.auto.description: Give a folder with no color of its own a stable one picked from its name.

folderTheme.colors.markdownDescription: Named colors, added to or replacing the defaults (`red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `teal`, `blue`, `purple`, `pink`). A value is a hue (0-360) or `#rrggbb`: `{ "blue": "#3b82f6", "brand": 300 }`. Used by `folderTheme.folders` and the automatic color.

folderTheme.parts.description: Which parts of the window are tinted.

folderTheme.danger.description: Dangerous (production) places: a folder name (all of it) or `folder/path` (that path, `*` and `**` allowed). While the active file is in one, the title bar is red and the status bar shows PROD.

folderTheme.protectedBranches.description: The status bar turns amber while the active folder's repository is on one of these branches. Empty to turn it off.
